voiceSummary: Ansal Properties and Infrastructure Limited issued a cease and desist notice to promoter group shareholders, including Shri Sushil Ansal, Shri Pranav Ansal, Smt. Sheetal Ansal, and Pranav Ansal and Sons HUF. The notice challenges the validity of an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for Monday, 23 November 2026. The company states that voting rights for the relevant shares ceased and vested in the Share Pledge Trustee, Vistra ITCL India Limited, due to a Deed of Pledge dated 25 August 2023 and a subsisting Event of Default. The Board demands the immediate withdrawal of the EGM notice dated 27 October 2026. The company warns of legal proceedings before the NCLT, SEBI, and other authorities if the meeting proceeds. Additionally, the announcement confirms that Shri Navneet Kumar Gupta continues as Resolution Professional for Rajasthan projects, while Raj Gang is appointed for Uttar Pradesh projects, per NCLT orders.

attchmntText: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has informed the exchanges that S&P Global Ratings assigned a preliminary long-term issuer credit rating of BBB+ with a stable outlook to Sun Pharma Global Treasury Centre IFSC Limited. This indirect wholly owned subsidiary is considered a core entity equalized with its parent. The rating reflects the subsidiary's role in financing and treasury operations, particularly for the proposed acquisition of Organon and Co. Sun Pharma expects to complete this acquisition in the first quarter of 2027. The preliminary rating on the parent is subject to securing necessary approvals for the transaction and ensuring the pro forma capital structure remains neutral to the rating. S&P anticipates the debt to EBITDA ratio will improve to about 1.8x in fiscal 2028, versus net cash in fiscal 2026.

voiceSummary: Birla Corporation Limited disclosed that the Expert Appraisal Committee under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change recommended granting Environmental Clearance for the Sagmania Limestone Mine. This recommendation is subject to compliance with stipulated conditions. The company must submit a bank guarantee of Rs. 1.85 Crore for remediation and resource augmentation plans. Additionally, the company must pay Rs. 80.93 lakh as a penalty under the Standard Operating Procedure dated 07/07/2021. attchmntText: SJVN Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 23, 2026, titled "Hon ble Prime Ministers of India and Nepal Jointly LayFoundation Stone of SJVN s 669 MW Lower Arun Hydro Electric Project".
voiceSummary: SJVN Limited filed a press release regarding the foundation stone laying for its 669 MW Lower Arun Hydro Electric Project in Nepal. The project, developed by wholly owned subsidiary SJVN Lower Arun Power Development Company Pvt. Ltd., has an estimated cost of Rs. 5,792.36 crore. The tentative tariff is Rs. 4.99 per unit, with annual energy generation of approximately 2,901 million units. The project integrates with the 900 MW Arun-3 Hydro Electric Project for tandem operation. It comprises four generating units of 167.25 MW each. Construction is underway under a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer basis. Commissioning is targeted for financial year 2030-31. The Government of Nepal awarded the project on 29th January 2021.
